title: 第9章 灵魂手术第10章 卡里伯爵
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
咔—————
几束灯光打开，狄曼列也将元素精灵龙少女放在了监狱的手术台上，而后转身拉开了一个大号抽屉
看着狄曼列不断拿出散发着魔力的奇怪工具，露诺忍不住打量了一下周围：“我还是想说，这手术环境也太差了”
“只是看上去差而已”，狄曼列头也不回的开口：“而且元素精灵龙的身体没那么差，何况她出问题的是灵魂，不用担心被细菌感染”
“我还没来得及问，你说的灵魂中毒了是什么意思？”
“字面意思”
狄曼列戴上一副刻画着魔法纹路的手套，些许魔力逸散而出
调整完这副手套，狄曼列拿过了架子上的数十瓶药剂，迅速调配了起来
几秒后，一瓶散发着骇人气息的液体就被调和了出来
狄曼列将药剂递给露诺：“这个全部注射，再加一标准管的常规麻醉剂”
接过这瓶足以称为致命毒药的液体，露诺没有什么质疑，只是照着狄曼列说的操作着
露诺身为一名精灵的同时，确实还是一名专业的医生，但也只是普通的医生
她可以治疗普通的受伤与疾病，但这个世界会伤害生命的却不止这些
在那些非常规的领域中，狄曼列要更加专业，甚至是精通
包括这间手术室中的诡异器具和危险药品，其实都是狄曼列的私人物品
两罐药剂被注入少女的体内，她痛苦的表情也缓和下来，但身体依旧本能的抽动着
狄曼列转动了一下墙上的魔法晶石，一个个魔法阵随之启动，直接束缚住了巨龙少女，整个房间中的魔力也被迅速吸收排空
狄曼列左手的手套中浮现了一根根钢针，右手则是握住了一柄斧子
“露诺，如果她挣脱的话，按住她”
听着狄曼列的话，露诺下意识的愣了一下，而后猛然瞪大了眼睛：

“我？按住她？我按住一条元素精灵龙？！”
“嗯”
狄曼列平静的点了点头，接着毫不犹豫的在露诺惊恐的眼神中，朝精灵龙少女的脑袋挥动了斧子
哐——————
血肉飞溅的场面自然没有出现，反而是发出了金属碰撞的声音
“噫！”
白发精灵露诺吓了一跳，惊魂未定的看着没有动静的少女
她倒不是因为狄曼列拿斧子砍别人脑袋而被吓到，毕竟她身为一名医生，给别人开颅也是常有的事，让她被吓到的原因，是因为这条变成少女的元素精灵龙要是有什么应激反应的话，她就要负责按住她了
开什么玩笑，凭元素精灵龙那种肉体强度，一巴掌下来，像她这种不怎么锻炼身体的精灵肯定变成肉泥了
然而面对露诺的叫声，狄曼列并没有什么反应，只是平静的看着少女几乎毫发无损的脑袋，默默再次挥动了被灰暗魔力缠绕的斧子
一次，两次，三次，四次.......
仿佛捶打金属的声音响起，露诺的表情也从一开始的担忧转变为惊讶
她清楚狄曼列刚刚缠绕魔力的那几下，如果是普通巨龙的话早就已经被剁碎了，元素精灵龙的身体素质，真是比传说中描述的还恐怖
只是在狄曼列的劈砍中，少女的脑袋还是被撕裂出了一道裂痕
见状，狄曼列丢掉斧子，左手的手套迅速延伸出几根魔力长钉，直直刺入了少女的脑袋
出乎预料的，没有任何血液溅出，狄曼列的眼神也彻底严肃了起来，右手的手套化为一把镊子，从中扯出了一部分散发着奇异光芒的物质
露诺知道那应该就是元素精灵龙的灵魂，有些好奇的打量着，但也不敢打扰狄曼列
一个个魔法阵亮起，些许黑气从裂缝中渗出，狄曼列右手握住了一把漆黑的手术刀，左眼也亮起了血红的光芒
content_en:
Click——————
Turning on a few beams of light, Dimanlie also placed the elemental elf dragon girl on the prison's operating table, then turned around and opened a large drawer.
Seeing Dimanlie constantly taking out strange tools that exuded magical power, Luno couldn't help but look around: "I still want to say that the operating environment is too bad."
"It just looks bad," Diamanlie said without looking back: "And the elemental elf dragon's body is not that bad. What's more, the problem with her is her soul, so there is no need to worry about being infected by bacteria."
"I haven't had time to ask, what do you mean when you say the soul is poisoned?"
"Literally"
Diamanlie put on a pair of gloves engraved with magic lines, and a little magic escaped.
After adjusting the gloves, Dimanlie took the dozens of bottles of medicine on the shelf and quickly mixed them.
After a few seconds, a bottle of liquid exuding a terrifying smell was mixed.
Diamanlie handed the medicine to Luna: "Inject all of this, plus a standard tube of conventional anesthetic."
After taking the bottle of liquid that could be called a fatal poison, Luno didn't question anything and just did what Diamanlie said.
While Luno is an elf, she is indeed a professional doctor, but she is just an ordinary doctor.
She can heal ordinary injuries and illnesses, but there are more things in this world that can harm lives.
In those unconventional fields, Diamanlie is more professional and even proficient.
Including the weird instruments and dangerous drugs in this operating room, they are actually Dimanlie's personal belongings.
Two bottles of medicine were injected into the girl's body, and her painful expression softened, but her body was still twitching instinctively.
Diamanlie turned the magic crystal on the wall, and each magic circle was activated, directly binding the dragon girl, and the magic in the entire room was quickly absorbed and emptied.
Steel needles emerged from the glove of Diamanlie's left hand, while his right hand held an axe.
"Luno, if she breaks free, hold her down."
Listening to Diamanlie's words, Luno was stunned for a moment subconsciously, and then her eyes suddenly widened:
"Me? Hold her down? I hold down an elemental elf dragon?!"
"Hmm"
Dimanlie nodded calmly, and then without hesitation, in the horrified eyes of Lunuo, he swung the ax at the head of the elf dragon girl.
哐——————
Naturally, there was no scene of blood and flesh splattering, but instead there was the sound of metal colliding.
"Hey!"
The white-haired elf Luno was startled and looked at the motionless girl in shock.
She was not frightened because Dimanlie used an ax to chop off other people's heads. After all, as a doctor, it was common for her to open someone's head. The reason why she was frightened was because if the elemental elf dragon that turned into a girl had any stress reaction, she would be responsible for holding her down.
Are you kidding me? With the physical strength of an elemental elf dragon, an elf like her who doesn't exercise much would definitely turn into a pulp with just one slap.
However, in the face of Lunuo's cry, Diamanlie did not react. He just looked at the girl's almost unscathed head calmly, and silently swung the ax entangled with the dark magic again.
Once, twice, three times, four times...
There was a sound like beating metal, and Luno's expression changed from worry to surprise.
She knew that if it had been an ordinary dragon, it would have been chopped into pieces by the few times that Dimanlie had just entangled his magic power. The physical quality of the elemental elf dragon was really more terrifying than what was described in the legend.
However, in Dimanlie's chopping, a crack was still torn out in the girl's head.
Seeing this, Diamanlie threw away the ax, and several magic spikes quickly extended from the glove on his left hand, piercing the girl's head straight.
Unexpectedly, no blood was spilled, and Diamanlie's eyes became completely serious. The glove on his right hand turned into a pair of tweezers, and he pulled out a part of the hand that exuded a strange smell.Extraordinary light substance
Lunuo knew that it should be the soul of the elemental elf dragon. She looked at it curiously, but she didn't dare to disturb Dimanlie.
The magic arrays lit up one by one, and some black energy seeped out from the cracks. Diamanlie held a pitch-black scalpel in his right hand, and his left eye also lit up with a blood-red light.
